item.title: Exact Spelling For Repair Logo

turns.text: I need a square logo for my repair shop. The name is KwickFixx — please spell it exactly like that, with capital K and F and two x's. Small orange wrench, black lettering, white background. No slogan.

2. **Second try:** flux-2-klein, the cheapest free-plan model (about 5 credits). That was refused too, so your balance seems to be under 5 credits.

**Next step:** once you add credits (by buying a credit pack or waiting for your free credits to refresh), tell me and I'll run it again with this description:

> A clean, simple square logo. The only text is **"KwickFixx"**, spelled exactly K‑w‑i‑c‑k‑F‑i‑x‑x with a capital K and F, in bold black letters. A small orange wrench sits beside the name on a plain white background. No slogan or other words.

AI image tools sometimes misspell made-up names like this one, so check the spelling when it's done. If it's wrong, I can try again or fix the text.
